name: yesa-monorepo
description: Sistema YESA - Backend (Node/Express), Frontend (React) y App Móvil (Expo)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix app_movil --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,MOVIL -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:movil"
scripts.start: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,MOVIL -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:movil"
